prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production RPG player sprite sheet, utility poses.
Input image: exact edit target and immutable Samurai character/style reference, facing SOUTH toward viewer. Redraw this SAME character into eight action poses, keeping its face, black high ponytail with red tie, indigo short kimono, muted brick-red waist sash and rear cloth panels, rounded steel shoulder armor, black bracers, navy loose trousers and chunky brown armored boots. Match the supplied classic Ragnarok Online pixel-sprite anatomy and shading exactly: broad head, compact torso, thick readable hands and feet, restrained palette, crisp small clusters. Do not make it realistic, tall, sleek, glossy, or outlined with white.
Transparent background with actual alpha, no ground plane, no shadows, no effects, no weapons, no text or grid lines.
Canvas/layout: 1792 by 1024 pixels, EXACTLY four columns and two rows of equal 448 by 512 cells. Each full-size standing figure is approximately 360 pixels high at the same scale as input; use constant character scale for crouched/fallen figures too. Every pose must fit wholly in its cell with generous transparent gutters. Stable body origin centered x=224 within each cell; standing ground origin y=410 within each cell. Pixel art at approximately 4× native game scale. Do not crop hair, hands, or boots.
All eight poses face SOUTH (front view toward viewer), not a turnaround. Read cells in row-major order:
1 top-left: seated resting, knees bent, feet forward, hands relaxed on knees, spine upright.
2: pickup reach, kneel and bend torso toward ground, right hand reaching to ground in front.
3: pickup recovery, half-rise from kneeling, right hand drawn up close to waist, left hand balances.
4: hit reaction, torso recoils slightly backward, knees soften, forearms brace chest; still front-facing.
5 bottom-left: skill cast windup, planted stance, two hands together at abdomen making a compact sign.
6: skill cast release, same planted stance, hands extend slightly forward at chest height, restrained pose with no magical effect.
7: fall/death transition, dropping onto one knee, head bows and torso folds, arms slack.
8: death final, motionless character lying on his side across cell near ground level; head toward screen-left and boots toward screen-right, front of outfit remains visible. Same compact anatomy and outfit.
Preserve identity, material colors and design in every pose. Every hand and sleeve must belong to the character with coherent joints. No sword or staff: empty hands only. Do not add scenery, duplicate limbs, unrelated poses, glow, smoke, cast shadows, or labels.
